This is the matching world-v1/mongolian-400-018.woff2 from the
Railway Atlas public font package. The underlying Noto Sans Mongolian
Regular is by Google and the Noto project, under OFL-1.1 (see OFL.txt).
The CSS family alias is Atlas Mongolian. See scripts/build-world-fonts.py
for how deployed slices are produced. This copy lets a clean browser
verify the packaged font offline instead of using the platform's
installed fonts or making a network request.
